tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Exile and Return, only mentioned at Neh.12.42
§ Izrahiah or Jezrahiah = "Jehovah will shine"
1) a chieftain of Issachar
2) a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Jizrachjah, the name of two Israelites
strongs_1890.derivation: from H2224 (זָרַח) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah will shine;
